title: trace eval corpus candidate
description: One JSON-lines entry in `eval/candidates.jsonl`. Validated as each harvested CVE is appended. A candidate's shape is identical to a frozen corpus entry (see `eval/corpus.json`) except that it has NOT yet passed eligibility. Carries `harvested_at` and `harvested_by` so the harvesting provenance stays on the record. If the candidate is later rejected, a corresponding line goes into `eval/rejection-log.jsonl` and this entry stays in candidates.jsonl unchanged — candidates.jsonl is append-only and includes everything ever considered.

candidate_source.description: Where the harvester first encountered this candidate. Informational — not a policy input — but later lets reviewers ask whether the corpus was sourced narrowly or broadly.

historical_fix.description: Ground-truth fix reference. At least one of the listed sub-fields SHOULD be present; candidates without any reachable historical fix are rejected per INCLUSION_RULES.md § Eligibility #3.

patch_shape.description:
Shape of the nixpkgs fix. Determines whether a sandbox-positive Reproducer is feasible: 'overlay' shapes (patches += [./CVE-NNNN.patch] or cherry-picked commits applied via patches) allow reconstructing the unpatched derivation by filtering the patch out (libtiff template); 'version-bump' / 'hash-bump' shapes change pkgs.<attr>.src to a new tagged release, and reconstructing unpatched src requires a network fetcher — which the Reproducer parser's no-fetcher rule blocks. See docs/DECISIONS.md 2026-05-13 (Reproducer v2 rerun) for the underlying contract finding. Values:
  * `overlay` — fix lands via `patches += [...]` or cherry-pick applied as patches; src unchanged.
  * `version-bump` — fix lands via `version = "X.Y.Z"` (usually + new src hash); src points at a new archive.
  * `hash-bump` — only source hash changes (rare; CDN re-pin, not a CVE-fix shape).
  * `mixed` — version bump PLUS additional fetchpatch overlay (e.g., bump-to-Y AND apply a post-Y commit). The CVE-class trigger may live in the overlay component.
  * `unknown` — harvester could not determine the shape from available evidence; flagged for re-classification.

Filtering on `patch_shape == "overlay"` is the recommended pre-filter for sandbox-positive candidate selection.
